name: XTR crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer average 629 g for the exact FC-M9020-2 reference with 175 mm arms and 34/24T chainrings, explicitly excluding the bottom bracket in the 2019 specification table. Other arm lengths and ring options do not inherit this mass.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2019 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 348: XTR crank variants, chainring combinations and average weights explicitly at 175 mm without bottom bracket
